The '''sclarin''' were a [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of creature that could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. They were a dangerous, raptor-like species of [[kilassin]].
